title: Super Mario Bros. (NES)
rom_note: US PRG dump; addresses from a Data Crystal summary, none verified in an emulator yet

sources.dc: Data Crystal Super_Mario_Bros./RAM_map (datacrystal.tcrf.net/wiki/Super_Mario_Bros./RAM_map), read 2026-11-16 via a summarizing fetch; re-check the wiki table before trusting exact labels

variables.name: stage
variables.meaning: stage in world (1-1=0); chapter goals use it with [$0772]==3

variables.name: game_mode
variables.meaning: 00 demo, 01 normal play, 02 world ends, 03 game over (dead); values above 02 crash | oper mode 0 title/demo, 1 play, 2 castle-axe ending (verified)

variables.name: level_load
variables.meaning: level load/restart setting; setting 03 mid-level can warp to a bonus level (do not write)

variables.name: palette
variables.format: enum 0 normal,1 underwater,2 night,3 underground,4 castle
variables.meaning: level palette

variables.name: player_state
variables.meaning: 06 player dies, 0B dying, 07 entering area, 08 normal, 09/0A size change (no movement), 0C transforming to fire, 01 vine, 02 reversed-L pipe entry, 03 down pipe, 04/05 autowalk | engine state: 8 normal, 7 pipe/intro walk, 4 flagpole, 5 level end walk, 0x0B dying (verified 6/11 death, 4/5/7/8)

variables.name: float_state
variables.meaning: 00 standing on solid ground, 01 airborne by jump, 02 airborne by walking off a ledge, 03 sliding down the flagpole | 0 on ground (verified as landed test)

variables.name: x_page
variables.meaning: player horizontal position in level, high byte | x page (verified)

variables.name: x_screen
variables.meaning: player X on screen (low byte of level X) | x in page (verified)

variables.name: y_screen
variables.meaning: player Y on screen; multiply by $00B5 for level Y

variables.name: y_viewport
variables.meaning: vertical screen position: 1 in view, 0 above view, >1 below view (rises to 5 when falling down a pit)

variables.name: lives
variables.meaning: Mario lives | lives, 0-based, starts 2 (verified)

variables.name: world
variables.meaning: world | world, 0-based (verified 0->1 after 1-4)

variables.name: area
variables.meaning: area number inside the stage (changes at pipes; verified 1-2 intro=1, underground=2)

variables.name: powerup
variables.meaning: power-up state

variables.name: size
variables.format: 0 big, 1 small, 2 blocks cannot be hit, 5 forces small
variables.meaning: player size, changes on hit and mushroom

variables.name: x_speed
variables.meaning: horizontal speed; negative left, 0 still, small positive right

variables.name: x_speed_abs
variables.meaning: absolute horizontal speed

variables.name: y_speed
variables.meaning: vertical velocity; jump about -5 (FB), fastest fall +5

variables.name: timer_100
variables.meaning: game timer digit

variables.name: timer_10
variables.format: BCD digit (tens); middle digit assumed, not listed by dc

variables.name: timer_1
variables.meaning: game timer digit

variables.name: score
variables.meaning: score

variables.name: coins
variables.meaning: coins per dc label; dc also says it is set to 1 on the prelevel screen, so the label may be wrong

variables.name: invincible_timer
variables.meaning: invincibility timer

variables.name: timer_control
variables.meaning: 02 freezes game time (do not write in a route)

variables.name: death_music
variables.meaning: death music loaded; usually set on falling deaths

variables.name: event_music_buffer
variables.meaning: if set, a fall or hit while small does not kill, but movement is blocked at screen bottom until cleared

variables.name: event_music_reg
variables.meaning: 20 = level ending music, 04 = ending theme

variables.name: pause_timer
variables.meaning: pause status; $0777 is the pause timer that must reach 0 before pausing or unpausing

unknown: level-end states at $000E (dc lists none; flagpole is $001D=03)
a dedicated title-screen flag (title = $0770 at 00 demo or not yet 01; check in the emulator)
area number byte (dc gives only $0760 as Level)
